title: Enlarge buffer cache and align planner I/O costs to cut GetUserTweets terminal occupancy
configuration_cause: shared_buffers=16384 (128MB) is tiny versus 2TB RAM, so the GetUserTweets working set is not retained; low_buffer_hit_ratio is active and DataFileRead/BufferIO waits appear. Planner costs (random_page_cost=4, seq_page_cost=1, effective_io_concurrency=1) undervalue cached random reads, reinforcing physical I/O on the dominant transaction.
mechanism: GetUserTweets consumes 88.5% of finite client terminal time at p50=196us/p95=410us, so its per-call physical read cost directly caps TPS. Raising shared_buffers retains the hot tweets working set, cutting DataFileRead/BufferIO stalls. Raising effective_cache_size and effective_io_concurrency plus lowering random_page_cost/seq_page_cost makes the planner prefer cached index paths and prefetch, reducing per-call latency and terminal occupancy. This is the mandatory buffer_cache_capacity bundle, distinct from the refuted predicate-lock action.
query_effect: Cached index scans on tweets replace physical DataFileRead paths for GetUserTweets; planner favors index over seq scans with lower random_page_cost.
expected_tps_effect: Increase successful_transaction_tps by reducing GetUserTweets terminal occupancy.

predictions.rationale: Larger cache and cache-aware planner costs cut physical reads on the dominant transaction.
Lower terminal occupancy on GetUserTweets frees terminal capacity for more completions.
Better cache retention reduces IO wait backends.

alternatives.statement: If GetUserTweets latency is dominated by WAL sync rather than buffer misses, the buffer bundle will not move p95 and the wal_commit_path bundle is the real lever.
If the working set already fits and DataFileRead waits are incidental, buffer enlargement yields no measurable TPS change.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves shared_buffers at 128MB with low_buffer_hit_ratio active and 2TB RAM available; the mandatory buffer_cache_capacity bundle directly targets the dominant transaction's physical-read cost, which the refuted predicate-lock action did not address.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: 4x current 128MB to 512MB, within safe range 8192-65536; ample RAM (2TB) makes this safe.
Raise to 8GB estimate, within 131072-1048576; reflects large host RAM.
Increase prefetch concurrency from 1 to 32, within 0-256.
Slight reduction paired with random_page_cost, within 0.5-2.0.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: I/O cost scale paired with random_page_cost

cross_domain_requirements: wal_commit_path bundle remains a competing mechanism for wal_wait; not executed here
